welcome.title: Welcome to TS Cortex Studio
welcome.subtitle: Choose your language to get started.

gameSettings.title: Game settings
gameSettings.subtitle: Name and icon used on PC (window title, installed programs) and console.
gameSettings.icon_hint: Square PNG (512×512 or larger recommended). Becomes the launcher icon.
gameSettings.shortcut_note: The desktop shortcut will come with the installer, using this same icon.
gameSettings.steam_hint: The app number from Steamworks. Required to export for Steam — without it the export fails. Leave empty if this game isn't going to Steam. (480 = Spacewar, for testing.)
gameSettings.steam_invalid: The Steam App ID must contain digits only.
gameSettings.chat_strong_label: AI Chat: Orchestrator with the strongest model (Coding always uses it)
gameSettings.chat_strong_hint: Better code on hard tasks, but uses up the usage quota much faster. Applies only to this project, on this computer.

chat.title: AI Chat
chat.tooltip_mode_ask: Ask: each destructive tool asks for approval. Click for Auto.
chat.tooltip_mode_auto: Auto: tools run without asking approval. Click for Plan.
chat.tooltip_mode_plan: Plan: the AI researches and proposes a plan; you approve before it implements. Click for Ask.
chat.plan_ready: Plan ready. Approve to implement or reject to adjust.
chat.plan_approved_prompt: Plan approved. Implement the plan you proposed.
chat.placeholder_input: Ask something... (Enter sends, Shift+Enter for newline)
chat.health_stalled: No activity for {idle} — it may be stuck. If the current step shouldn't take this long, click Stop.
chat.open_first_for_paste: Open a project before pasting images.
chat.confirm_clear: Discard all chat history for this project?
chat.tooltip_task_orchestrator: Orchestrator mode: the AI decides from the request what goes to Modeling and what it codes itself. Click for Modeling.
chat.tooltip_task_modeling: Modeling mode: 3D models, scenes and effects. Does not change code. Click for Coding.
chat.tooltip_task_coding: Coding mode: the game code — systems, mechanics, scripts and UI. Click for Orchestrator.

characterRig.title: Character auto-rig
characterRig.subtitle: Drag the markers onto the body, like Mixamo. Writes tools/characters/<CODE>.markers.json.
characterRig.hint: Drag a circle onto the model, or drag on the model to move it. L = the character's left (right side of the screen).
characterRig.view_hint: Wheel: zoom · drag background: pan · double-click: reframe
characterRig.no_webgl: WebGL unavailable: cannot show the model.
characterRig.loaded_mismatch: Markers read from {file}, but its code/source do not match the config.
characterRig.estimated: Positions estimated from the model's bounding box. Adjust and save.
characterRig.sheet_open: Click to open the sheet in the system viewer

outcome.review: Waiting for visual review (code {code}): check the sheet.
outcome.published: Published to the game (code {code}). The preview shows the published rig; run the game validation.
outcome.notPublished: Not published (code {code}): stages are pending or failed. Generate the rig again.

err.chinBelowGroin: The chin must be above the groin.

characterRig.no_configs: No character config with "skinned" in tools/characters/.
characterRig.not_skinned: This config has no "skinned" section (or is invalid).

anim.need_rig: Generate this character's rig first (not in tools/characters/rigs.json, or the GLB is missing).
anim.pending_hint: Selected in the config but not in the rig: generate the rig again to include it.

arm.title: Arm adjustment (this clip)
arm.apply_all_hint: Copies this clip's 6 values to every clip in skinned.clips and saves the config.
arm.apply_all_confirm: Apply {name}'s adjustments (shoulders {lift}, arms {space}, forearms {elbow}, shoulders back {back}, arm twist {armTwist}, forearm twist {foreTwist}) to all {count} clips in skinned.clips and save the config? The other clips' current values will be replaced.
arm.applied_all: Applied to {count} clips and saved to {file}.
arm.hint: Like Mixamo's Character Arm-Space: saved in the config's skinned.clips (shoulderLift/armSpace/elbowSpace/shoulderBack/armTwist/foreArmTwist) and baked into the GLB on the next generation. For the twists, + turns the palm forward (external rotation). The preview shows the generated GLB with the difference on top.
arm.no_clip: Play a clip to adjust the arms.
arm.not_in_config: Clip {name} is not in the config's skinned.clips: it can't be adjusted.
arm.generated: In the GLB: shoulders {lift}, arms {space}, forearms {elbow}, shoulders back {back}, arm twist {armTwist}, forearm twist {foreTwist}.
arm.regen: Changed: generate the rig again (the preview shows the GLB + the difference: shoulders {lift}, arms {space}, forearms {elbow}, shoulders back {back}, arm twist {armTwist}, forearm twist {foreTwist}).

pose.title: Pose (this clip)
pose.move_hint: X/Y/Z arrows or drag the dot (free, on the camera plane): hand and foot use two-bone IK; other joints turn the parent bone. The hips do not move (rotate only).
pose.rotate_hint: The gizmo rings rotate the selected bone.
pose.none_selected: Click a skeleton joint to select it (Esc or clicking empty space clears it).
pose.hips_fixed: The hips do not move: use Rotate (E).
pose.bones_empty: No posed bones in this clip.
pose.apply_all_hint: Copies this clip pose to every clip in skinned.clips and writes the config.
pose.apply_all_confirm: Apply the pose of {name} ({bones} bones) to all {count} clips in skinned.clips and write the config? The current pose of the other clips will be replaced.
pose.applied_all: Pose applied to {count} clips and written to {file}.
pose.no_clip: Play a clip to pose the skeleton.
pose.not_in_config: Clip {name} is not in the config skinned.clips: it cannot be posed.
pose.regen: Pose changed: generate the rig again (the preview shows the GLB + the difference).
pose.switch_confirm: The pose of {name} is not saved. Switch anyway? The edit is kept until you save or reset it.
pose.hint: Per-clip pose, joint by joint (no mirroring): written to skinned.clips[clip].pose in the config and baked into the GLB on the next generation. W move, E rotate, Esc clears the selection, Ctrl+Z undoes.

fbx.no_dir: The config has no skinned.fbx (FBX folder).
fbx.empty: No .fbx in the folder or its subfolders.
fbx.play_hint: Click to play in the Animations tab
fbx.flags_hint: Flags the game uses on this clip
fbx.confirm_remove: The game uses {names}: there are flags beyond file/loop (rootMotion, jump…). Remove from the selection anyway?

review.rejected: Rejected: nothing was published. Adjust the markers (or the selection) and generate again.
review.revert_confirm: Undo the last publication? The game goes back to the files from before it.
